summary: Vault wiki page lookup, search, lint, ingest, and log.

help:
Usage: wiki [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Vault wiki: page lookup, search, lint, ingest, log.

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  page    Print a vault page by slug.
  query   Keyword search over vault pages.
  ingest  Ingest a source document into the vault.
  lint    Lint the vault and regenerate index.md.
  log     Tail the vault log.
help.page:
Usage: wiki page [OPTIONS] {slug}

  Print a vault page by slug.

Arguments:
  slug  Page slug  [required]

Options:
  -f, --format <str>  concise|detailed  [default: concise]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
help.query:
Usage: wiki query [OPTIONS] {query}

  Keyword search over vault pages.

Arguments:
  query  Search terms  [required]

Options:
  -s, --scope <str>   Wiki sub-scope (e.g. projects/agent-hub)
  -n, --limit <int>   Result count  [default: 10]
  --include-memories  Also print related memory IDs from frontmatter
  --help              Show this message and exit.
help.ingest:
Usage: wiki ingest [OPTIONS] {target}

  Ingest a source document into the vault.

Arguments:
  target  Local file path  [required]

Options:
  -s, --scope <str>  Sub-scope under sources/
  --help             Show this message and exit.
help.lint:
Usage: wiki lint [OPTIONS]

  Lint the vault and regenerate index.md.

Options:
  -s, --scope <str>   Limit scan to wiki sub-scope
  --stale-days <int>  Pages older than this many days are stale  [default: 90]
  --help              Show this message and exit.
help.log:
Usage: wiki log [OPTIONS]

  Tail the vault log.

Options:
  -n, --last <int>  Show last N day-entries  [default: 10]
  --help            Show this message and exit.

usage.when: read a vault page by slug
precautions: detailed emits full body — only when drilling

usage.when: search the vault for matching pages
precautions: keyword + title-boost ranking; no embeddings yet
scope is a wiki subpath, e.g. projects/agent-hub

usage.when: explicitly add a source document into the vault
precautions: local paths only for now; URL ingest deferred — use `st web fetch --raw` then ingest the saved file
copies into vault/sources/[scope]/ with timestamp prefix; appends log entry
flags orphans, broken wikilinks, stale last_verified, missing frontmatter
